_comment: Tiger I - TZF 9d binocular telescope. On the real instrument the arc scales are a RANGE DRUM readout, not drop marks: the gunner dials a range, the reticle shifts, and he then simply puts the chevron on the target. Superb Warfare has no range drum, so the arcs here show MEASURED range with a travelling pointer, and the short ladder under the chevron is what actually lays the gun. Copying the arcs as drop marks would look right and aim wrong.
_optics: Mask / CommanderMask / Furniture are OPTIONAL. The aperture and every reticle line are drawn from geometry, so no art is required. If you add a PNG later, name it here and it is layered over the drawn mask; a path that does not resolve is skipped rather than painting the missing-texture magenta.
_ladders: Velocity must match the matching ammo Velocity in data/warsteel/sbw/vehicles/tiger-h1.json, or the loaded round is never emphasised and every scale draws faint.
